name: range-slider
title: Range slider
description: Slider with two handles for a range such as a price from 20 to 80. Drag or use the arrow keys; handles never cross.
htmlExample:
<bef-range-slider class="w-80" :value="[20,70]" emit="value-change" id="g1"></bef-range-slider>
<script type="module">
document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  format: (n) => `₹${n}k`,
};
</script>
